id.title: 5 ‘Pusat Maritim’ Menjadi Lebih Penting Setelah Guncangan Hormuz: Apa Strategi Bertahan Hidup Kor...
id.description:
Dengan adanya blokade Selat Hormuz akibat perang antara AS dan Iran, hal ini memberikan pukulan besar bagi perekonomian global, termasuk sektor energi dan logistik.

Secara khusus, insiden ini telah meningkatkan perhatian pada pentingnya "titik strategis maritim," seperti selat dan kanal, yang berfungsi sebagai jalur utama bagi rantai pasokan global.

en-US.title: 5 Maritime Chokepoints That Matter More After the Hormuz Shock: What Are South Korea’s Energy and...
en-US.description:
With the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz due to the war between the U.S. and Iran, it is dealing a major blow to the global economy, including the energy and logistics sectors.

In particular, this incident has brought greater attention to the importance of "maritime strategic points," such as straits and canals, which serve as key passages for global supply chains.

We will take a closer look at the five maritime strategic points, in addition to Hormuz, that are critical to Korea, and examine Korea's survival strategies amidst the war for hegemony in energy and logistics.

We are joined by Professor Kim Jin-soo of the Department of Resource and Environmental Engineering at Hanyang University and Professor Lee Sang-yoon of the Asia-Pacific Logistics School at Inha University.

en-US.title: Samsung Electronics management and labor at a stalemate… General strike set to proceed despite ex...
en-US.description:
Vice Chairman Jeon Young-hyun, who leads Samsung Electronics’ DS Division, has set out to tighten internal discipline, warning executives not to "rest on their laurels."

The Samsung Electronics leadership even issued a public apology, appealing to the labor union to return to dialogue.

However, the union maintains its stance of proceeding with a general strike, and signs of internal rifts are even appearing.

Reporter Gu Min-jeong reports.

id.description:
Wakil Ketua Jeon Young-hyun, yang memimpin Divisi DS Samsung Electronics, telah berupaya memperketat disiplin internal, memperingatkan para eksekutif untuk tidak "berpuas diri."

Pimpinan Samsung Electronics bahkan mengeluarkan permintaan maaf publik, dan mengimbau serikat pekerja untuk kembali berdialog.

Namun, serikat pekerja tetap mempertahankan pendiriannya untuk melanjutkan pemogokan umum, dan tanda-tanda perpecahan internal bahkan mulai muncul.
